# Collections


::: {.callout-tip}
`invoke-toolkit` extends [`invoke`](https://docs.pyinvoke.org/en/stable/) classes and functions prepending `ToolkitXXX`
for each extended class.

For compatiblity, when you do `from invoke_toolkit import task, Context` the names are preserved.
:::


`invoke-toolkit` comes with a set of built-in collections. These
collections are visible with the `-x` flag, and listed with `-l`, like:

```shell
$ uvx invoke-toolkit -xl

Available tasks:

config.show (config)             Shows the contents of the configuration in the context
create.add-shebang (create.x)    Adds the uv shebang to scripts.
create.package (create.p)        Creates a package for tasks using the invoke-toolkit copier
                                 template.
create.script (create.s)         Creates a new script
```
